name: Maestros Electronics & Telecommunications Systems Limited
about: Maestros Electronics & Telecommunications Systems Limited manufactures and sells medical equipment and telemedicine products. It operates through three segments: Medical, Electronics and Instrumentation, and Telemedicine. The company provides critical care products, such as ECG machines, patient monitors, defibrillators, pulse oximeters, spirometers, syringe pumps, and stress test machines; mother and child care products, including fetal monitors and wireless fetal monitor; and telemedicine solutions. It offers its products and services for financial inclusion, cardiology, gynecology, critical care patient, and diseases management in medicine. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
